a.lede: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
a.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you

b.lede: Shopify’s new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize their online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, while watching the changes happen in real time.
b.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
